第十一章神秘地牢
阳光明媚的上午，墓园内就仿佛处于阴暗的地下室，根本感受不到一丝阳光的温暖。
郝宁来到了墓园的西角落，这里长满了茂密的藤蔓，混乱无比，突然他愣住了，他上次来到这里时并没有这些藤蔓，这里是一堵光洁的墙壁，而在墙壁上就有一个细微的机关用来开启密道的大门。
但现在那个机关不见了！
“怎么可能！难道因为上次我被抓，这条通道已经被封闭了？”郝宁脑袋里一片混乱，他是因为这条密道才来到这里的，但现在密道竟然消失了，而且如果他不是通过这条密道，就很难悄悄地进入子爵那守卫森严的房子。
“或许他们是在我被捕后，悄悄更改了密道的位置防止秘密的暴露！不过他真的不怕被教堂的人知道？”他对此没有感到一丝奇怪，这些贵族谁没有一条逃命的密道，有的贵族甚至会在居所里面建立一座定向传送郑，防止一些突**况。
就在这时候发生了一件郝宁意想不到的事情，那些翠绿色的藤蔓就像是蛇群般涌向他的身体，转眼间就将他捆住，无论他怎么挣扎都无济于事。
只见郝宁一头扎进藤蔓中，这些锋利的荆棘仿佛利刃般划伤他的皮肤。
眼看郝宁就要撞上藤蔓后面的墙体了，忽然嘭的一声闷响，瞬间墙体仿佛一块木板般被郝宁的身体撞开，骤然间他感到一阵失重感，整个人滚进昏暗的通道内。
在郝宁进去后，那堵墙体竟然缓缓恢复原状，也没人注意到墓园角落中消失了一个人。
“啊，真疼！”
郝宁只感到自己撞上了坚硬的石板，背上的疼痛使他瞬间清醒过来，这条密道内没有一丝光亮，就来自己的手脚的都难以看清。
隐约间空气中还传来一丝腐臭的味道，就仿佛一大堆死老鼠堆积着的下水道，更奇怪的是他身上的藤蔓竟然消失得一干二净。
“这里不是我上次来到的通道，奇怪，这里是哪里？”
郝宁向着四周摸索了一阵子后，他发现这里好像不是上次所来到的密道，上次的密道应该有两米多宽，但是现在他张开双手后，这里的空间竟然只能刚好让他伸展身体。
忽然郝宁犹豫了，他望着通道前进的方向，感觉这不是通往韦伯利的房子，而是另外一个地方。
“该死，现在已经没有退路了！”郝宁回头摸了一下身后的入口，但整个墙壁都光滑平整，没有任何可以触发的机关。无奈之下郝宁只好按照这条唯一的通道继续前行。
随着郝宁的前行，空气中的腐臭越来越严重，他不得不掩住鼻子才能继续前行，而且郝宁感受到他自己正在以一个圆形的姿态不断在往地底深处走去。
“呼！”一声轻轻的叹息在黑暗中回荡着，郝宁的汗毛瞬间竖了起来，人类的恐惧往往是来自于未知，而这黑暗中仿佛有一只噬人巨兽在等待着他的前往。
“该死，这里究竟是什么鬼地方！”虽然郝宁的身体一下子变得强壮起来，但并不代表他会不害怕鬼怪这些东西，而且还是在这个昏暗无比的狭窄通道内！时间在一点点流逝，郝宁站在原地没有动。

他再也受不了这渗人的黑暗了，他从商店系统中以1购买点数的代价兑换处一把燃烧的火把，在摇曳的火光的照耀下，通道顿时变得明亮起来，就连头上的蜘蛛丝也能看得一清二楚。
忽然间郝宁回头望向身后，静悄悄的，没有一丝动静，他的眉头不由皱了起来，难道刚刚的是错觉？刚刚他可是感觉到身后站着一个人，冰冷的气息直直呼在他脖子上。
然而当郝宁回过头去的时候在他身后竟然矗立着一个漆黑的身影，苍白的脸孔有着一丝怨恨，就连光芒照射在它身上都会减弱几分。但这一切郝宁根本没有发现。
他走了不知道多久，感觉脚都快断掉了，忽然前面不远处竟然有一丝微弱的光芒，郝宁心中一喜，小心翼翼地隐匿着脚下的声音往那边走去！
“啊！啊！”
“该死，这里究竟是哪里？某个亡灵法师的地牢？”
一声渗人的哀嚎声在光源传出的方向响起，但郝宁却没有停下脚步，迈着沉重步伐继续往发出亮光的地方走去，那道光芒似乎是在通道尽头的门中发出的！
“天呐！这是……生化危机吗！”走到通道尽头后，郝宁看这样眼前的情景后再也掩盖不住脸上惊骇的表情，他脑海里前一秒还猜测这些声音究竟是什么发出来的，但是万万没想到，在他眼前竟然有一群皮肤腐烂的丧尸。
郝宁忍住十分恶心想吐的感觉跨进这道门，腐臭的气息铺天盖地地涌过来，这里简直就是一个比垃圾场还要臭的地方。
上百平方的圆形建筑用铁栏围住了，只剩下中心处的一点空地供活人走动，那些腐烂的丧尸“看到”郝宁这个活人后，都疯狂地嚎叫着，希望得到这块新鲜美味的血肉。
天呐！想不到这里竟然有这么多的亡灵，要知道整个艾诺尔世界都禁止使用亡灵魔法，因为亡灵魔法太可怕了，一个强大的亡灵法师可以令一个小型国家覆灭！
郝宁小心翼翼地避开这些狰狞丧尸伸出的利爪，同时他也在留意着这间圆形牢房的布置，中心的空地并不宽敞，直径只有三米左右，而中间的地板上还放着一个半米多高的木制箱子，不过在郝宁眼中这个更像是一只棺材。
里面究竟装着什么东西？里面会不会是亡灵法师摆放着的宝物呢？郝宁不由对这个棺材产生了巨大的兴趣，心中更是在拼命地猜测着。
“嗒嗒嗒！”
就在这时候外面的通道竟然想起了一阵稳健的脚步声，很有节奏地接近着这里，郝宁能够听出这是两个人的脚步声，步履不一致！
糟了，他可不想变成牢笼里面那样活着的死尸！郝宁的心瞬间慌起来了，他可不认为脚步声的主人也是跟他一样是误闯进来的！
丧尸的嘶吼声仿佛成了郝宁的催命符！随着脚步声的接近，郝宁的额前已经渗出冷汗，要知道这里只有那么一条通道，出去后就会撞上脚步声的主人，但留在这也会被那个人发现。
“韦伯利，这次的实验一定会成功的吗，你放心！”这时候通道外传来一把令郝宁惊骇不已的声音！

Chapter 11 Mysterious Dungeon
On a sunny morning, the cemetery feels like being in a dark basement, with no warmth from the sun at all.
Hao Ning came to the west corner of the cemetery. It was covered with dense vines and was extremely chaotic. Suddenly he was stunned. There were no such vines when he came here last time. There was a smooth wall here, and there was a subtle mechanism on the wall to open the door to the secret passage.
But now that mechanism is gone!
"How is that possible! Could it be that this passage has been closed because I was arrested last time?" Hao Ning's head was in confusion. He came here because of this secret passage, but now the secret passage has disappeared, and if he had not passed this secret passage, it would be difficult to quietly enter the Viscount's heavily guarded house.
"Perhaps they quietly changed the location of the secret passage after I was arrested to prevent the secret from being exposed! But is he really not afraid of being known by people in the church?" He was not surprised at all. None of these nobles had a secret passage to escape. Some nobles would even build a directional teleportation tower in their residence to prevent some emergencies.
At this moment, something unexpected happened to Hao Ning. Those emerald green vines swarmed towards his body like a swarm of snakes, tying him up in the blink of an eye. No matter how hard he struggled, it was to no avail.
Hao Ning plunged into the vines, and the sharp thorns scratched his skin like sharp knives.
Seeing that Hao Ning was about to hit the wall behind the vines, there was a sudden muffled sound, and the wall was knocked open by Hao Ning's body like a wooden board. Suddenly he felt a sense of weightlessness, and his whole body rolled into the dim passage.
After Hao Ning entered, the wall slowly returned to its original state, and no one noticed that a person disappeared in the corner of the cemetery.
"Ah, it hurts!"
Hao Ning only felt that he had hit a hard stone slab, and the pain on his back made him wake up instantly. There was no light in this secret passage, and it was difficult to see even his own hands and feet.
There was a faint rotten smell in the air, like a sewer where a lot of dead rats were piled up. What was even stranger was that the vines on his body had disappeared completely.
"This is not the passage I came to last time. It's strange. Where is this?"
After Hao Ning groped around for a while, he found that this place did not seem to be the secret passage he came to last time. The last secret passage should be more than two meters wide, but now that he opened his hands, there was only enough space for him to stretch his body.
Suddenly Hao Ning hesitated. He looked in the direction of the passage and felt that it was not leading to Webley's house, but to another place.
"Damn it, there's no way out now!" Hao Ning turned around and touched the entrance behind him, but the entire wall was smooth and flat, with no mechanism that could be triggered. In desperation, Hao Ning had no choice but to continue moving along this only passage.
As Hao Ning moved forward, the rancid smell in the air became more and more serious. He had to cover his nose to continue moving forward, and Hao Ning felt that he was walking deeper into the ground in a circular posture.
"Hoo!" A soft sigh echoed in the darkness, and Hao Ning's hair stood up instantly. Human fear often comes from the unknown, and there seemed to be a man-eating giant beast waiting for him in the darkness.
"Damn it, what the hell is this place!" Although Hao Ning's body suddenly became stronger, it does not mean that he is not afraid of ghosts and monsters, and he is still in this extremely dark and narrow passage! Time passed little by little, and Hao Ning stood there without moving.
He couldn't stand the seeping darkness anymore, so he exchanged a burning torch from the store system for 1 purchase point. Under the flickering light of the fire, the passage suddenly became brighter, and even the spider silk on his head could be seen clearly.
suddenlyThen Hao Ning turned around and looked behind him. It was quiet and without any movement. He couldn't help but frown. Could it be that what just happened was an illusion? Just now, he felt someone standing behind him, with cold breath blowing directly on his neck.
However, when Hao Ning turned around, there was a dark figure standing behind him, with a trace of resentment on his pale face, and even the light shining on it was weakened a bit. But Hao Ning didn't notice all this at all.
He walked for who knows how long, and it felt like his legs were about to break. Suddenly there was a faint light not far ahead. Hao Ning felt happy and walked there carefully hiding the sound under his feet!
"Ah! Ah!"
"Damn it, where is this place? A certain necromancer's dungeon?"
A permeating wail sounded in the direction of the light source, but Hao Ning did not stop and continued walking towards the place where the light came out with heavy steps. The light seemed to come from the door at the end of the passage!
"Oh my God! Is this... a biohazard?" After reaching the end of the passage, Hao Ning could no longer hide the horrified expression on his face after seeing the scene in front of him. A second ago, he had guessed what the sounds were coming from, but he never expected that there would be a group of zombies with rotting skin in front of him.
Hao Ning resisted the feeling of nausea and vomiting and stepped through the door. The putrid smell rushed over overwhelmingly. This place was simply a smellier place than a garbage dump.
The circular building of hundreds of square meters was surrounded by iron bars, leaving only a small open space in the center for living people to walk around. After the rotting zombies "saw" Hao Ning, a living person, they howled crazily, hoping to get this piece of fresh and delicious flesh and blood.
Oh my God! Unexpectedly, there are so many undead here. You must know that the use of undead magic is prohibited in the entire world of Ainol, because undead magic is too terrible. A powerful necromancer can destroy a small country!
Hao Ning carefully avoided the claws extended by these ferocious zombies. At the same time, he also paid attention to the layout of this circular cell. The open space in the center was not spacious, only about three meters in diameter, and there was a wooden box more than half a meter high on the floor in the middle. However, in Hao Ning's eyes, this was more like a coffin.
What exactly is inside? Could it be the treasures placed by the Necromancer? Hao Ning couldn't help but have a huge interest in this coffin, and he was desperately guessing in his heart.
"Ta-ta-ta!"
At this moment, a steady sound of footsteps was heard in the passage outside, approaching here rhythmically. Hao Ning could tell that these were the footsteps of two people, and their steps were inconsistent!
Damn it, he doesn't want to become a living dead body like in the cage! Hao Ning's heart suddenly panicked. He didn't think that the owner of the footsteps had broken in by mistake just like him!
The roar of the zombies seemed to be Hao Ning's reminder! As the footsteps approached, cold sweat broke out on Hao Ning's forehead. You must know that there is only one passage here. If you go out, you will bump into the owner of the footsteps, but if you stay here, you will be discovered by that person.
"Webley, this experiment will definitely be successful, don't worry!" At this time, a voice came from outside the passage that shocked Hao Ning!
